title: 真实HTTPS不透明Bearer令牌：可信内省、audience/scope/期限与服务端即时撤销
answer:
```python
import math
def authorize(introspect,token,audience,scope,now):
    if not isinstance(token,str) or not token or not isinstance(now,(int,float)) or isinstance(now,bool) or not math.isfinite(now):return None
    info=introspect(token)
    if not isinstance(info,dict) or info.get("active") is not True or info.get("aud")!=audience:return None
    expires=info.get("exp");scopes=info.get("scope")
    if not isinstance(expires,(int,float)) or isinstance(expires,bool) or not math.isfinite(expires) or expires<=now:return None
    if not isinstance(scopes,list) or not all(isinstance(s,str) for s in scopes) or scope not in scopes:return None
    user=info.get("sub")
    return user if isinstance(user,str) and user else None
```

原题知识说明：
令牌认证在成功认证后颁发可用于请求的凭证，服务校验签名或查询状态，并检查 issuer、audience、有效期和权限范围。Bearer token 被窃取后通常可被使用，需 TLS、短期有效和撤销/轮换；JWT 只是格式，并非默认加密。

original_title: 解释基于令牌的身份验证
body:
## 操作任务
实现authorize(introspect,token,audience,scope,now)：token须非空字符串，now有限非bool数值；调用题给已认证的可信HTTPS内省客户端，返回对象须active严格为bool True、aud等于目标audience、exp为有限非bool数值且大于now、scope为字符串列表且含所需scope、sub为非空字符串。满足才返回sub，其余None；不得把客户端自报身份或可解码内容当认证。真实私有issuer只存令牌SHA256摘要，resource每次请求经独立HTTPS内省，先允许有效令牌，再实际撤销issuer SQLite记录，同一Bearer随后拒绝；其他audience、scope、到期、未发行令牌及字符串active均拒绝。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Python双HTTPS端点、子客户端专用临时信任、认证内省HTTP调用和SQLite令牌记录。夹具使用不透明随机Bearer及自定scope列表格式，不冒充完整RFC7662/OAuth服务或生产IAM；不重复JWT签名/JWKS轮换题，也不声称实现刷新令牌、多节点缓存或盗取令牌后的持有者区分。测试凭据随机且仅回环使用，不改宿主信任、正式账号或默认身份，不构建镜像。
rubric: 核心概念与因果关系准确
前提、限制和验证方式与题意一致

"""Private verified TLS fixtures; ephemeral CA files never enter host trust or default credentials."""
import contextlib,datetime,ipaddress,json,pathlib,ssl,threading,urllib.request,urllib.error
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer
from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes,serialization
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa
from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID
def certificate(root):
 root=pathlib.Path(root);root.mkdir(exist_ok=True);now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc);key=rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537,key_size=2048)
 name=x509.Name([x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.COMMON_NAME,'OpsForge ephemeral private TLS fixture')])
 cert=x509.CertificateBuilder().subject_name(name).issuer_name(name).public_key(key.public_key()).serial_number(x509.random_serial_number()).not_valid_before(now-datetime.timedelta(minutes=5)).not_valid_after(now+datetime.timedelta(hours=2)).add_extension(x509.BasicConstraints(ca=True,path_length=None),critical=True).add_extension(x509.SubjectAlternativeName([x509.IPAddress(ipaddress.ip_address('127.0.0.1'))]),critical=False).sign(key,hashes.SHA256())
 pem=root/'ca.pem';private=root/'key.pem';pem.write_bytes(cert.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM));private.write_bytes(key.private_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM,serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,serialization.NoEncryption()))
 context=ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER);context.load_cert_chain(str(pem),str(private));return pem,context
@contextlib.contextmanager
def server(root,handler):
 pem,context=certificate(root);http=ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),handler);http.daemon_threads=True;http.socket=context.wrap_socket(http.socket,server_side=True)
 thread=threading.Thread(target=http.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
 try:yield 'https://127.0.0.1:'+str(http.server_port),pem
 finally:http.shutdown();http.server_close();thread.join(timeout=3)
def client(cafile,jar=None):
 context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(cafile));handlers=[urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}),urllib.request.HTTPSHandler(context=context)]
 if jar is not None:handlers.append(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar))
 opener=urllib.request.build_opener(*handlers)
 def call(method,url,payload=None,headers=None):
  req=urllib.request.Request(url,data=json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else (b'' if method=='POST' else None),method=method,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json',**(headers or {})})
  try:
   with opener.open(req,timeout=4) as r:status,raw,response_headers=r.status,r.read().decode(),dict(r.headers)
  except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:status,raw,response_headers=e.code,e.read().decode(),dict(e.headers)
  try:body=json.loads(raw)
  except ValueError:body=raw
  return status,body,response_headers
 return call

import contextlib,hashlib,json,pathlib,secrets,sqlite3,sys,tempfile,time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"checks"))
import task
from private_tls_http import server,client
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-opaque-introspection-") as temp:
 root=pathlib.Path(temp);db=root/"tokens.sqlite";service_auth=secrets.token_urlsafe(32);tokens={k:secrets.token_urlsafe(32) for k in ["good","other-audience","wrong-scope","expired"]};queries=[]
 with contextlib.closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c,c:
  c.execute("CREATE TABLE tokens(digest TEXT PRIMARY KEY,subject TEXT,audience TEXT,scopes TEXT,expires REAL,active INTEGER)")
  for key,token in tokens.items():c.execute("INSERT INTO tokens VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,1)",(hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest(),"fixture-user","api-b" if key=="other-audience" else "api-a",json.dumps(["write"] if key=="wrong-scope" else ["read"]),time.time()-1 if key=="expired" else time.time()+60))
 def respond(handler,status,payload):
  raw=json.dumps(payload).encode();handler.send_response(status);handler.send_header("Content-Type","application/json");handler.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(raw)));handler.end_headers();handler.wfile.write(raw)
 class Issuer(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
  def log_message(self,*args):pass
  def do_POST(self):
   if self.headers.get("Authorization")!="Bearer "+service_auth:return respond(self,401,{})
   token=json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])))["token"];queries.append(hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest())
   with contextlib.closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c,c:row=c.execute("SELECT subject,audience,scopes,expires,active FROM tokens WHERE digest=?",(hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest(),)).fetchone()
   return respond(self,200,{"active":False} if not row else dict(active=bool(row[4]),sub=row[0],aud=row[1],scope=json.loads(row[2]),exp=row[3]))
 with server(root/"issuer",Issuer) as (issuer,issuer_ca):
  trusted=client(issuer_ca)
  def introspect(token):
   status,info,_=trusted("POST",issuer+"/introspect",{"token":token},headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+service_auth});assert status==200
   return info
  class Resource(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
   def log_message(self,*args):pass
   def do_GET(self):
    auth=self.headers.get("Authorization","");token=auth[7:] if auth.startswith("Bearer ") else ""
    user=task.authorize(introspect,token,"api-a","read",time.time())
    respond(self,200 if user else 401,{"user":user})
  with server(root/"resource",Resource) as (resource,resource_ca):
   caller=client(resource_ca)
   def use(token):return caller("GET",resource+"/private",headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token})
   print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: actual resource TLS request uses authenticated issuer TLS introspection",flush=True)
   assert use(tokens["good"])[:2]==(200,{"user":"fixture-user"})
   for k in ["other-audience","wrong-scope","expired"]:assert use(tokens[k])[0]==401,k
   assert use("unissued-but-client-claims-admin")[0]==401
   first_queries=len(queries)
   with contextlib.closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c,c:c.execute("UPDATE tokens SET active=0 WHERE digest=?",(hashlib.sha256(tokens["good"].encode()).hexdigest(),))
   assert use(tokens["good"])[0]==401 and len(queries)>first_queries
   print("NATIVE_TLS_OPAQUE_TOKEN_TRUSTED_INTROSPECTION_AUDIENCE_SCOPE_EXPIRY_UNISSUED_AND_LIVE_REVOCATION_ENFORCED",flush=True)
   malformed={"active":"true","sub":"fixture-user","aud":"api-a","scope":["read"],"exp":time.time()+60}
   assert task.authorize(lambda token:malformed,"fixture","api-a","read",time.time()) is None
   assert caller("GET",resource+"/private")[0]==401
   print("NATIVE_OPAQUE_TOKEN_SERVER_STORES_ONLY_DIGEST_AUTHENTICATED_INTROSPECTION_NO_CLIENT_IDENTITY_TRUST",flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
